newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.

text.p: * Intel Corp reported after Tuesday's stock market close that its profits more than doubled in the fourth quarter. Earnings per share rose to $2.13 from $0.98 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $1.84.
Intel shares were up five at 152-1/2 overnight in London.
* Republic New York Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.78, compared with $1.54 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 83-3/8 Tuesday.
* Fleet Financial Group Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.07, up from $0.94 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 52-1/4.
* Wachovia Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.99, compared to $0.85 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 56-7/8.
* BankAmerica Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.90, compared to $1.74 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 101-3/4.
* Norwest Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.81, up from $0.72 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 46.
* PNC Bank Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.78, compared to $0.60 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 38-3/4.
* First Chicago NBD Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.15, compared to $0.96 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 54-1/8.

* In London, International Business Machines Corp shares were up 1/2 at 167-3/8 while Texas Instruments Inc gained 1/2 to 68. Digital Equipment Corp was up 3/8 at 35-3/8, helped by news of a large order.
